alerts.title: CVE-2026-70595
alerts.description: Ghost is a Node.js content management system. From 6.26.0 until 6.54.1, a validation issue allowed some functionality, such as Webmentions, to be abused by an unauthenticated user to make limited HTTP requests to hosts in the Ghost server's internal network. A successful attack would not result in any response data being returned. This vulnerability is fixed in 6.54.1.

alerts.title: CVE-2026-71314
alerts.description: Nuxt is an open-source web development framework for Vue.js. From 3.1.0 until 3.21.10 and 4.5.1, an unauthenticated attacker can use a server island v-for prop, including vforToArray and , to trigger unbounded SSR memory allocation until MAX_VFOR_LENGTH = 100000 and crash the Nuxt process. This issue is fixed in 3.21.10 and 4.5.1.

alerts.title: CVE-2026-71315
alerts.description: Nuxt is an open-source web development framework for Vue.js. From 3.21.7 until 3.21.10 and 4.5.1, mixed-case routeRules keys can fail to match case-folded lookups when router.options.sensitive is false and drop appMiddleware authorization gates. This is caused by an incomplete fix for CVE-2026-53721. This issue is fixed in 3.21.10 and 4.5.1.

alerts.title: CVE-2026-71316
alerts.description: Nuxt is an open-source web development framework for Vue.js. From 4.4.0 until 4.5.1, runtime cache:nuxt:payload entries for /<page>/_payload.json can be returned before route middleware and page guards because import.meta.prerender is not enforced, disclosing another user's SSR data. This issue is fixed in 4.5.1.

alerts.title: CVE-2026-71318
alerts.description: Nuxt is an open-source web development framework for Vue.js. From 3.1.0 until 3.21.10 and 4.5.1, an attacker can supply a top-level `as` prop to the /__nuxt_island/ endpoint and drive dynamic component resolution through <component :is>, resolveDynamicComponent, or h(). This issue is fixed in 3.21.10 and 4.5.1.

alerts.title: CVE-2026-71320
alerts.description: Nuxt is an open-source web development framework for Vue.js. From 3.4.0 until 3.21.10 and 4.5.1, an attacker can inject a template key through /__nuxt_island/ props into a dynamic component when `vue.runtimeCompiler: true` is enabled, causing template execution in the Nitro process. This issue is fixed in 3.21.10 and 4.5.1.

alerts.title: CVE-2026-71321
alerts.description: Nuxt is an open-source web development framework for Vue.js. From 3.1.0 until 3.21.10 and 4.5.1, the internal island renderer endpoint `/__nuxt_island/...` decodes and hashes attacker-controlled JSON body input with destr and ohash before validating the URL-resident hash. alerts.title: Node.js Foundationのundiciにおけるインジェクションに関する脆弱性
alerts.description: undiciのsetCookie関数は、クッキー属性を完全にサニタイズしていません。undiciのバージョン6.28.0未満、7.0.0から7.29.0未満、および8.0.0から8.9.0未満では、ドメイン値にセミコロンが含まれていないかどうかのチェックがされず、未解析配列のエントリもサニタイズされないため、攻撃者が影響を与えた入力によって追加のクッキー属性を注入される可能性があります。例えば、セミコロンを含むドメイン値はSameSiteなどの属性を付加でき、未解析のエントリは呼び出し元が設定していないHttpOnlyなどの属性を注入することが可能です。マルチテナントやリバースプロキシサーバーのように、ユーザー制御の入力をこれらのフィールドに渡してテナント提供のドメインにセッションクッキーをスコープするアプリケーションでは、SameSiteによるCSRF保護が回避されたり、Secure、HttpOnly、SameSite属性が強制的に設定されたり、除去・上書きされたりする可能性があります。この問題はundiciのバージョン6.28.0、7.29.0、および8.9.0で修正されています。...
